condition_contract.gradient_direction: positive components point uphill in local east/north coordinates
condition_contract.contour_tangent_semantics: the tangent is an unoriented line, so t and -t are equivalent
condition_contract.anti_leakage: condition slices recover only the file projection origin; every feature is sampled from the source raster at the simulated position

velocity_model.signed_uphill_speed: dot(v, normalized_terrain_gradient); positive uphill and negative downhill
velocity_model.velocity_to_contour_line_distance: abs(signed_uphill_speed); Euclidean distance from velocity vector to the unoriented contour tangent line

protocol.exploratory_gain_rule: mean paired candidate-minus-primary-comparator Energy Score below zero and candidate better on at least two of three registered seeds
protocol.rule_scope: descriptive exploratory gate; not an inferential scientific verdict
